name: @gatedpath/agent-rules
description: One source of truth for Redbelly Network agent rules, rendered to CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor MDC, Copilot instructions, GEMINI.md, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, plus the one table of failure messages the MCP server, the frontend kit and the site share.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n')" && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/esm/cli.js',0o755)"
scripts.samples: npm run build && node dist/esm/cli.js --out generated-samples && node scripts/update-readme.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-chains-built.mjs && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/unit.test.mjs test/failures.test.mjs
